newsitem.title: USA: Techs lead Nasdaq to third consecutive win.
newsitem.headline: Techs lead Nasdaq to third consecutive win.

text.p: A rally in technology shares pushed Nasdaq shares higher for the third consecutive session, traders said.
The Nasdaq composite index gained 14.70 points or 1.19 percent to 1251.43. The Dow industrials added almost 30 points to 6556.
"The whole tech sector has been so beaten down for weeks. We've had some positive momentum the past few days that continue in the major names today," one trader said.

Leading the Nasdaq gain was Cisco Systems Inc, which added 3-9/16 to 54-7/16 after the company released details of its expanded product line. Several brokerage firms also reaffirmed bullish ratings on the stock. Microsoft Corp gained 1-11/16 to 95-7/8, Cascade Communications Corp increased 1-5/16 to 31-1/2 and Ascend Communications Inc added 1-5/16 to 47-5/8.

Investors, however, sold shares of Rational Software Corp after it agreed to buy rival Pure Atria Corp in a stock deal initially valued at $839 million. Rational Software lost 9-3/4 to 13-5/8 and Pure Atria dropped 7-3/4 to 10. Overall, advancing issues beat declining issues 2465 to 1784 on total volume of about 576 million shares.
